ale_last_exam.name: ale_last_exam
ale_last_exam.purpose: Agents' Last Exam long-horizon professional workflow in a real sandbox with hidden-reference, artifact-first GUI+CLI delivery
ale_last_exam.purpose_zh: Agents' Last Exam 长程专业工作流：在真实沙箱中按隐藏参考答案、以产物优先的方式完成 GUI+CLI 交付

chip_design.name: chip_design
chip_design.purpose: end-to-end digital ASIC/accelerator design from workload and microarchitecture through RTL, physical implementation, and sign-off
chip_design.purpose_zh: 端到端数字 ASIC/加速器设计：从工作负载与微架构到 RTL、物理实现与签核

classical_poetry.name: classical_poetry
classical_poetry.purpose: compose or check classical Chinese 近体诗/古体/词 with reproducible 押韵/平仄 prosody and literary review
classical_poetry.purpose_zh: 创作或校验中文近体诗/古体/词，押韵、平仄以可复现的方式机器检查，并做文学评审

digital_circuit.name: digital_circuit
digital_circuit.purpose: Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL, testbenches, formal verification, FPGA/ASIC synthesis, timing, and sign-off
digital_circuit.purpose_zh: Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL、测试平台、形式验证、FPGA/ASIC 综合、时序与签核

digital_circuit_benchmark.name: digital_circuit_benchmark
digital_circuit_benchmark.purpose: single-stage fixed-harness RTL benchmark: interface, RTL, local verification, pre-score elaboration, and attempt handoff
digital_circuit_benchmark.purpose_zh: 单阶段固定评测框架的 RTL 基准：接口、RTL、本地验证、评分前展开与尝试交接

fiction_writing.name: fiction_writing
fiction_writing.purpose: write or continue original fiction narrative prose while preserving characters, world, and timeline; not a literature review or research task
fiction_writing.purpose_zh: 撰写或续写原创小说叙事文本，保持人物、世界观与时间线一致；不是文献综述或研究任务

kernelbench.name: kernelbench
kernelbench.purpose: maximize correctness-checked SOL score/speedup for GPU kernels on B200 SOL-ExecBench/KernelBench
kernelbench.purpose_zh: 在 B200 SOL-ExecBench/KernelBench 上最大化通过正确性检查的 GPU 内核 SOL 得分/加速比

literary_editor.name: literary_editor
literary_editor.purpose: rewrite, expand, polish, proofread, or critique an existing literary text while preserving edit scope and source facts
literary_editor.purpose_zh: 改写、扩写、润色、校对或评论既有文学文本，保持编辑范围与原文事实不变

materials.name: materials
materials.purpose: materials science and materials processing across atomistic, microstructure, continuum, CAD/CAE, and experimental scales
materials.purpose_zh: 材料科学与材料加工，跨原子、微观组织、连续介质、CAD/CAE 与实验尺度

medical.name: medical
medical.purpose: biomedical and pharmaceutical evidence execution: target-disease mechanisms, human genetics, preclinical translation, clinical trials, safety, failed programs, competitive pipelines, and auditable non-diagnostic decision dossiers with independent review; not a generic paper pipeline
medical.purpose_zh: 生物医药证据执行：靶点-疾病机制、人类遗传学、临床前转化、临床试验、安全性、失败项目、竞争管线，产出可审计的非诊断决策档案并独立评审；不是通用论文流水线

modern_poetry.name: modern_poetry
modern_poetry.purpose: compose or revise modern free verse/prose poems without classical prosody checks; enforce only declared hard constraints
modern_poetry.purpose_zh: 创作或修改现代自由诗/散文诗，不做古典格律检查；只执行声明的硬性约束

nanochat.name: nanochat
nanochat.purpose: minimize val_bpb on the nanochat train.py (bits-per-byte, ~300s, 1 GPU)
nanochat.purpose_zh: 在 nanochat 的 train.py 上最小化 val_bpb（bits-per-byte，约 300 秒，1 张 GPU）

nanogpt_speedrun.name: nanogpt_speedrun
nanogpt_speedrun.purpose: minimize wall-clock time to reach val_loss<=3.28 on modded-nanogpt (8xH100)
nanogpt_speedrun.purpose_zh: 在 modded-nanogpt（8xH100）上最小化达到 val_loss<=3.28 的墙钟时间

physics.name: physics
physics.purpose: theory, simulation, data analysis, literature, or experiment design for a real physical system with bounded evidence
physics.purpose_zh: 针对真实物理系统、在有界证据下进行理论、模拟、数据分析、文献或实验设计

prose.name: prose
prose.purpose: compose or revise literary essays, memoir, or 抒情/叙事散文/随笔; not verse or plot-driven fiction
prose.purpose_zh: 创作或修改文学随笔、回忆录或抒情/叙事散文/随笔；不是诗歌，也不是情节驱动的小说

quant.name: quant
quant.purpose: equity factor research (IC/ICIR, backtest, Sharpe) producing a reviewer-certified report, not a generic metric loop
quant.purpose_zh: 股票因子研究（IC/ICIR、回测、Sharpe），产出评审员认证的报告，不是通用指标循环

speedrun.name: speedrun
speedrun.purpose: single-metric script/benchmark optimization under a wall-clock budget: setup, optimize, measure, report; no paper
speedrun.purpose_zh: 墙钟预算内的单指标脚本/基准优化：搭建、优化、测量、报告；不写论文
